33 Latrobe Terrace, Paddington

Mesa haus,
a house for mornings.

Part cafe, part design shop, part co-working space, in one small house on Latrobe Terrace.

Open from 7am
weekdays

Some places are one thing. This haus is three, and it holds all of them before lunch.

Mesa Haus opened on 18 September 2026 at 33 Latrobe Terrace in Paddington. It is a cafe first, with coffee, matcha and pastries at the counter. It is also a design shop, with objects to browse while you wait, and a co-working space, with room to sit down and get something done.

The whole day here is a morning. Doors open at 7am on weekdays and 7:30am on weekends, and the haus closes at 1pm, which keeps it small, bright and unhurried.

On tap, whisked, and finished with foam.

Cold brew and hot batch brew are poured on tap. Matcha and hojicha are finished with cold foams, in vanilla sea salt or ube.

Cold brew on tap

Poured from the tap at the counter and served over ice.

Hot batch brew on tap

Filter coffee on tap, ready as soon as you walk in.

Matcha

Green and vivid, whisked to order and finished with cold foam.

Hojicha

Roasted tea, soft and toasty, finished with cold foam.

Vanilla sea salt cold foam

A cold foam finish for matcha and hojicha, sweet with a salt edge.

Ube drink, November special

Finished with ube cold foam, a nod to the founder's Filipino heritage.

One table. Three jobs.

Stay on this table and keep scrolling. The room around it changes, the table does not move. That is the whole idea of the haus.

Cafe Design shop Co-working

Pastries and things made in the haus.

Alongside the drinks, the counter carries pastries, haus made items and cookies. The selection changes, so what is on the trays is what there is that morning.

  • Pastries

    On trays at the counter, ready with coffee or tea.

  • Haus made items

    Made in the haus, alongside the pastry selection.

  • Cookies

    Small, rich, and made for the walk home as much as the table.
